review.finding: parse_colours only matched 6-digit hex; #fff, 8-digit hex, rgb(), hsl(), var() and non-px font sizes were silently skipped, so an override could fall back to the base value and report OK for a colour that was never checked.
review.suggestion: Report every colour or size value that is not readable; expand 3-digit hex.

review.finding: Step 5 'apply the darkest suggestion, run again until exit 0' does not converge for a dark on-primary (yellow brand) or a dark theme; lines without a hint were not covered.
review.suggestion: Say 'most contrasting', cap the re-runs, and give an exit: change the other side of the pair or ask the user.

review.finding: The suggestion test kept the last suggestion per token, not the darkest, and never showed that applying them makes check() return [].
review.suggestion: Group per token, keep the darkest, assert check(fixed) == [].

review.finding: A missing --font-size-base / --font-size-sm passed silently in --tokens mode while a missing colour was reported.
Dead inner conditional in the final print; docstring did not document exit 2.
review.suggestion: Simplify the print and document exit 2.

review.finding: --base accepted any string; a typo gave 'not found' instead of the valid names.
A darkened primary could end up darker than primary-hover; no rule checked the order.
review.suggestion: Check primary-hover is darker than primary and note it in step 5.
